rows.text: The world economic outlook remains positive.
Issued by Mr TT Mboweni, Governor of the South African Reserve Bank
Introduction
Preliminary estimates made by the International Monetary Fund indicate that world economic growth reached nearly 5 per cent in 2004 – the highest figure in almost three decades.
Moreover, this growth was widespread, with particularly high increases in China and other non-Japan Asian countries, the United States of America and a number of emerging market economies.
The world economic outlook remains positive.
